seo.title: Spend Easy — Private Expense Tracker for iOS
seo.description: Track expenses the simple way—without connecting your bank. Manual expense entry, budgets, categories, and charts. All data stays on your device.

hero.label: PRIVATE EXPENSE TRACKING
hero.title: Track expenses, no bank required.
text: A beautifully simple expense tracker that keeps your financial data where it belongs—on your device. No bank connections. No cloud sync. No accounts.

sections.title: Zero bank connections. Ever.
text: While other expense trackers want your banking credentials, Spend Easy takes a different approach. You enter expenses manually—giving you full control and complete privacy. Your bank login stays yours.

items.title: Manual Expense Entry
items.text: Add expenses in seconds. Enter amount, pick a category, add notes if you want. Clean and fast—designed for daily use.

items.title: Smart Budgets
items.text: Set daily, weekly, or monthly spending limits. Visual progress rings show exactly where you stand. Stay on track effortlessly.

items.title: Custom Categories
items.text: Create categories that fit your life. Choose icons and colors. Organize spending your way—not how some algorithm thinks you should.

items.title: Spending Charts
items.text: Beautiful visualizations show your spending trends. See category breakdowns, compare weeks and months, spot patterns.

items.title: Recurring Expenses
items.text: Track regular bills and subscriptions. Set it once, see it in your spending—never forget what's coming up.

items.title: Completely Private
items.text: No accounts. No cloud sync. No network requests. Your expense data lives on your device and nowhere else. Period.

sections.label: YOUR DATA. YOUR DEVICE.
sections.title: Privacy isn't a feature. It's the foundation.
text: No analytics. No tracking. No ads. No telemetry. Spend Easy will never ask for your bank login. Your financial data never leaves your device—not to our servers, not to anyone's.

cta.title: Start tracking.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
